title: Conditions raised by zusvg — zusvg-conditions
text: Every error zusvg raises carries condition class, can caught kind rather matching message, may change. Every class inherits zusvg_error.

title: Conditions raised by zusvg — zusvg-conditions
text: zusvg_invalid_argument argument unusable: input wrong type, limit positive whole number, bad colour. Carries arg, argument fault. zusvg_parse_error document one plutosvg can load: malformed, root <svg>, size positive. zusvg_encoding_error input UTF-8, holds NUL byte. zusvg_limit_error limit reached. Carries limit, argument's name, "max_size", limit_value. zusvg_missing_element id document. zusvg_render_error plutosvg render document. zusvg_memory_error allocation failed. zusvg_io_error file connection read written. zusvg_parse_error, zusvg_encoding_error zusvg_limit_error raised loading carries offset, 0-based byte offset fault input, NA position known: plutosvg's loader reports none, UTF-8 check.

title: zusvg 0.0.0.9000
text: Bundles plutosvg 0.0.8 plutovg 1.3.3 thirteen local patches. <use> hops now count 256-level render depth. loader fails cleanly allocation fails. Five smaller patches remove R CMD check report: three compiler warnings (one C23), sprintf() call diagnostic-suppressing pragma. svg_load(), svg_read(), svg_size() svg_validate() load SVG string, raw vector, connection file (gzip-compressed included) limits size, element count, nesting embedded images. svg_render() draws document, one element id, nativeRaster, RGBA array raw RGBA bytes, currentColor CSS var() colours supplied R; svg_extents() measures. <use> <symbol> sized <use> (patch 0008). svg_png() svg_jpeg() encode render, returning bytes writing file connection; svg_elements() lists document’s elements id. Text clip paths render warn per call (zusvg_text_skipped, zusvg_clip_skipped) unless quiet = TRUE. Hostile input bounded: render stops million element visits (zusvg_limit_error, limit = "render_steps"), dashed path million segments, embedded images larger 4096 pixels side decoded. Patches 0009 0013 fix fuzzer found. 64 64 icon loads renders 0.1 ms; see tools/run-benchmarks. zusvg_info() reports bundled versions, upstream tags commits, patches.
